Every other check passes, including C9 (scripts/), C9D (docs/), C12 (64 md files, was 63) and C13 (61, was 60) with this task's files in scope. So each check passes in every environment where it is measurable, and no redness is attributable to this task. The harness must be re-run once the sibling's .lean edits land.
